passage.text: It's almost midnight in Bangkok, and Nam is on a video call with Emma, who is back home in Canada.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈmɪdnaɪt ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ənd ˈnɑːm ɪz ɑːn ə ˈvɪdioʊ ˌkɔːl wɪð ˈɛmə, huː ɪz ˈbæk ˈhoʊm ɪn ˈkænədə.

passage.text: "Why aren't you in bed?" Emma asks.
passage.reading: ˈwaɪ ˈɑːrənt juː ɪn ˈbɛd? ˈɛmə ˈæsks.

passage.text: "There's a flash sale at midnight," Nam says. "The new Nova phone is only 9,999 baht!"
passage.reading: ðɛrz ə ˈflæʃ ˌseɪl ət ˈmɪdnaɪt, ˈnɑːm ˈsɛz. ðə ˈnuː ˈnoʊvə ˈfoʊn ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈnaɪn ˈθaʊzənd ˈnaɪn ˈhʌndrəd ˈnaɪnti ˈnaɪn ˈbɑːt!

passage.text: "But your phone is fine," says Emma. "You bought it last year."
passage.reading: bʌt jʊr ˈfoʊn ɪz ˈfaɪn, ˈsɛz ˈɛmə. juː ˈbɔːt ɪt ˈlæst ˈjɪr.

passage.text: "I know, but it's a great deal, and it's only for a limited time," Nam explains.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ, bʌt ɪts ə ˈɡreɪt ˈdiːl, ənd ɪts ˈoʊnli fər ə ˈlɪmɪtɪd ˈtaɪm, ˈnɑːm ɪkˈspleɪnz.

passage.text: "I also have a coupon for another five hundred baht off!"
passage.reading: aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈhæv ə ˈkuːpɑːn fər əˈnʌðər ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt ˈɔːf!

passage.text: "Nam, flash sales are designed to make you panic," Emma says.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈflæʃ ˈseɪlz ər dɪˈzaɪnd tə ˈmeɪk juː ˈpænɪk, ˈɛmə ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "You see the time counting down, and you think you have to buy now."
passage.reading: juː ˈsiː ðə ˈtaɪm ˈkaʊntɪŋ ˈdaʊn, ənd juː ˈθɪŋk juː ˈhæf tə ˈbaɪ ˈnaʊ.

passage.text: Nam looks at her old phone.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm ˈlʊks ət hɜːr ˈoʊld ˈfoʊn.

passage.text: It still works perfectly, and the battery is fine.
passage.reading: ɪt ˈstɪl ˈwɜːrks ˈpɜːrfɪktli, ənd ðə ˈbætəri ɪz ˈfaɪn.

passage.text: "Maybe you're right," she says. "I don't really need a new one."
passage.reading: ˈmeɪbi jʊr ˈraɪt, ʃiː ˈsɛz. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈriːli ˈniːd ə ˈnuː ˈwʌn.

passage.text: At midnight, the sale starts, and Nam closes the app.
passage.reading: ət ˈmɪdnaɪt, ðə ˈseɪl ˈstɑːrts, ənd ˈnɑːm ˈkloʊzɪz ði ˈæp.

passage.text: "I'm proud of you!" Emma says. "Now go to bed!"
passage.reading: aɪm ˈpraʊd əv ˈjuː! ˈɛmə ˈsɛz. ˈnaʊ ˈɡoʊ tə ˈbɛd!
